get.description: Served route `GET /api/v1/pipelines/{id}/recover`. Handler: `handleRecoverPipeline`. Response shape reflected from Go type `PipelineRecoveryEnvelopeResponse`. Uses the server's configured project, fixed for execution and HTTP idempotency replay; project and session overrides are not accepted. GET returns deliveries, commands, and selectors arrays containing receipt identities and acceptance eligibility without prompt, transcript, or captured output contents. POST records one explicit acceptance only; it does not launch work, signal processes, or infer settlement from a saved PID. Before accepting command or selector output, independently verify that the original process and all descendants have finished. Use the ordinary resume endpoint or a pipeline_resume job to continue.

403.description: Missing pipelines:read for inspection or pipelines:write for acceptance

409.description: Run is owned, receipt is stale, or the recovery decision conflicts with saved state

503.description: Configured project is unavailable or recovery storage failed; inspect recovery before retrying

post.description: Served route `POST /api/v1/pipelines/{id}/recover`. Handler: `handleRecoverPipeline`. Response shape reflected from Go type `PipelineRecoveryEnvelopeResponse`. Uses the server's configured project, fixed for execution and HTTP idempotency replay; project and session overrides are not accepted. GET returns deliveries, commands, and selectors arrays containing receipt identities and acceptance eligibility without prompt, transcript, or captured output contents. POST records one explicit acceptance only; it does not launch work, signal processes, or infer settlement from a saved PID. Before accepting command or selector output, independently verify that the original process and all descendants have finished. Use the ordinary resume endpoint or a pipeline_resume job to continue.

requestBody.description: One JSON object of at most 10 MiB including encoded output and metadata. Unknown fields are rejected. Exactly one of accept_delivery, accept_command, or accept_selector must be true. Every decision requires the exact receipt_token returned by inspection and an operator observation. Command and selector decisions additionally require explicit exit_code and output values; an empty string records observed empty output. Delivery decisions cannot supply outcome fields. Output is never truncated, and invalid UTF-8 or unpaired Unicode surrogates are rejected. Enabled redact/block modes reject detected secrets before persistence.

accept_command.description: Accept the independently verified final outcome of the inspected foreground command; requires exit_code and output.

accept_delivery.description: Accept the inspected agent delivery; mutually exclusive with accept_command and accept_selector.

accept_selector.description: Accept the independently verified final outcome of the inspected selector; requires exit_code and output.

exit_code.description: Explicit observed exit code from 0 to 255 for a command or selector. Omitted and null values are refused for these decisions.

output.description: Complete observed UTF-8 output, including an explicit empty string when no output was produced. Use stdout for selectors and commands with output_parse, otherwise combined stdout and stderr. The encoded request and frozen capture limits apply; binary selector output can be recovered through the CLI.

reason.description: Operator observation; after trimming whitespace, 1 to 4096 UTF-8 bytes. Enabled redact/block modes reject detected secrets with 422 SECRETS_DETECTED before persistence; submitted values are never replaced with placeholders.

receipt.description: Exact 64-character lowercase hexadecimal receipt_token returned by inspection.

403.description: Missing pipelines:read for inspection or pipelines:write for acceptance

409.description: Run is owned, receipt is stale, or the recovery decision conflicts with saved state

413.description: Encoded recovery request exceeds the server's 10 MiB body limit

422.description: Request redaction refused sensitive outcome data before persistence

503.description: Configured project is unavailable or recovery storage failed; inspect recovery before retrying

post.description: Served route `POST /api/v1/pipelines/{id}/resume`. Handler: `handleResumePipeline`. Response shape reflected from Go type `PipelineExecutionEnvelopeResponse`. By default this request waits for the resumed workflow and remains tied to the HTTP connection. Set background=true to continue the saved run in a detached worker that survives client disconnection and server exit. A 202 response acknowledges worker startup, not workflow completion; poll the existing run ID for status and use its cancel endpoint to stop it. Detached resume uses saved variables and rejects nonempty variable overrides. An omitted session is resolved from the checkpoint by the worker after it acquires run ownership.

requestBody.description: Resume the saved run; an empty body preserves synchronous behavior and saved session/variables.

background.description: Start a detached worker and return 202 after startup is accepted. Defaults to false; does not opt into restarting completed work.

max_materialized_step_nodes.description: Zero or a positive transient step-planning limit for this attempt. Zero uses the saved workflow.

max_selector_output_bytes_total.description: Zero or a positive selector-output byte budget for this attempt. Zero uses the saved workflow.

max_step_count_total.description: Zero or a positive distinct runtime-step admission limit for this attempt. Zero uses the saved workflow.

session.description: Optional session override; omitted keeps the saved session subject to normal resume identity checks.

variables.description: Variable overrides for synchronous resume only. A nonempty object is rejected when background=true; detached resume retains saved variables.

202.description: Detached resume accepted; response includes the saved run_id, workflow_id, session, pending status, progress, resumed=true, and background=true

409.description: Pipeline already has a live execution owner

504.description: Detached startup canceled or timed out before authorization

ActionStatusOutput.description: Inspect the current lifecycle state of any durable robot operation (--op-id / Idempotency-Key) or active --robot-wait handle by request ID: source, kind, status, terminal/cancellable flags, timestamps, and recorded outcome.

ActivityOutput.description: Get agent activity state (idle/busy/error) for all agents in a session.

AttentionOutput.description: The canonical tending primitive: wait until attention is needed, then return a digest with wake reason and next cursor. This is the one obvious way to implement an operator loop. Combines wait + digest semantics with cursor handoff for mechanical replay.

CancelRequestOutput.description: Cancel a pre-dispatch durable operation claim or an active --robot-wait handle by request ID. Safely refuses with REQUEST_ALREADY_DISPATCHED once pane actuation has begun, or REQUEST_NOT_CANCELLABLE when already terminal.

CapabilitiesOutput.description: Discover robot commands, optionally filtered or projected into a compact token-efficient catalog.

DashboardOutput.description: Dashboard summary as markdown or JSON.

DigestOutput.description: Aggregated summary of recent attention events. Returns counts, top items, and category breakdown without waiting. Use for quick status checks; prefer --robot-attention for blocking operator loops.

HealthOutput.description: Get session or project health status.

jsonl_path.description: J s o n l path

jsonl_sha256.description: J s o n l s h a256

InterruptOutput.description: Send Ctrl+C to stop agents, optionally send a new task.

PlanOutput.description: Get bv execution plan with parallelizable tracks.

PolicyDecisionsOutput.description: List durable policy and operator audit decisions from the runtime state store.

SendOutput.description: Send message to panes atomically. Supports type filtering and tracking.

SnapshotOutput.description: Unified state query: sessions + beads + alerts + mail. Use --since for delta snapshots.

SpawnOutput.description: Create session with agents and optionally wait for readiness or assign initial work.

StatusOutput.description: Get tmux sessions, panes, and agent states. The primary entry point for understanding current system state.

SuccessEnvelope.description: Generic success envelope. The handler's payload fields are merged at the top level alongside these envelope fields; this endpoint's payload shape is not registered in the robot schema registry, so only the envelope is documented.

TerseOutput.description: Single-line encoded state for minimal token usage.

TriageOutput.description: Get bv triage analysis with recommendations, quick wins, and blockers.

WaitResponse.description: Wait for pane-state, attention-feed, or evidence-backed convergence conditions and return a machine-usable wake result.
